result:
I’d make the boundary between “us” and “them” impossible to fully believe in.

Not by forcing agreement or making everyone nice—just by giving every person an inescapable, felt sense that the people they’re most tempted to fear, despise, or ignore are as real, complicated, and vulnerable inside as they are. Most cruelty depends on being able to turn someone into an abstraction. I’d remove that ability.
